issues: Previous iteration missing required stories for FEAT-1
notes: Added complete story set for Provider Search feature (schema, core logic, API integration, tests).

stories.title: Define Provider Search Input/Output Schema
stories.description: Implement and validate Pydantic models for provider search inputs (query, location, specialty) and structured outputs including provider metadata, distance, and taxonomy classification.

stories.title: Implement Vector Search with Taxonomy Fallback
stories.description: Build core provider search logic using MongoDB Atlas vector search with embedding similarity and implement fallback to NUCC taxonomy-based filtering when vector results are insufficient.

stories.title: Integrate Location Filtering and County Mapping
stories.description: Enhance provider search with geographic filtering including state, city, and county resolution using FIPS-to-county mapping and multi-stage narrowing.

stories.title: Expose Provider Search via FindCare Facade and Tool Router
stories.description: Integrate provider search service into FindCare facade and expose as a callable tool through the tool router with validated inputs and structured response formatting.

stories.title: Unit and Integration Tests for Provider Search
stories.description: Develop unit tests for schema validation and search logic plus integration tests covering vector search, taxonomy fallback, and location filtering through the tool router.
